entities.name: NtK-1 (Q40518)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (409 aa) to reviewed Nicotiana tabacum Shaggy-related protein kinase NtK-1.
Annotated as an ATP-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase (EC 2.7.11.1); may mediate extracellular signals to regulate transcription in differentiating cells.
Reference annotations place it in cytoplasm and nucleus; associated GO biological processes include signal transduction and cell differentiation.

entities.name: Arabidopsis GSK3-like kinases
observations: Close homolog annotations associate these kinases with phosphorylation and, for specific paralogs, meristem organization and salt-stress responses; these paralog-specific processes should not be assumed established for NtK-1.
